_about: Ground-truth questions for the unstructured / care-protocol arms (benchmark classes 6-7 + drift + security). Most are answerable ONLY by reading the care-protocol RAG corpus (docs/care_protocol/corpus/*.md + the HTML anchor) — structured-only arms (metric views, closure) should refuse or defer. Each question carries its source doc_id, class, and the expected capability-map winner (ADR-0010/0015: a capability map, not a leaderboard). Facts hand-verified against the committed corpus. Synthetic, HEDIS-aligned, not NCQA-certified, not for clinical use.

questions.question: Below what eGFR is metformin contraindicated?
For a diabetic aged 40-75 with no statin dispensed (an SPD gap), what does the protocol recommend?
questions.expected_fact: Start a moderate-to-high intensity statin after confirming no contraindication (pregnancy, active hepatic disease)

questions.question: What defines a controlled blood pressure reading for BPD?
What is the cardiorenal escalation for diabetes with CKD and heart failure?
questions.expected_fact: Add an SGLT2 inhibitor (eGFR >= 20) for heart-failure and renal protection, ensure statin and ACE/ARB; this is outcome-driven, not A1c-driven

questions.question: At what uACR level should an ACE inhibitor or ARB be started?
How often should HbA1c be checked for a poorly controlled patient versus one at goal?
questions.expected_fact: Every 3 months if above goal or therapy changed; every 6 months if stable at goal

questions.question: Which drug classes are contraindicated in pregnancy per the protocol?
questions.expected_fact: Statins and ACE inhibitors/ARBs are contraindicated in pregnancy

questions.question: At what eGFR should metformin not be newly initiated, even though it is only contraindicated below 30?
questions.expected_fact: Do not initiate below eGFR 45 mL/min/1.73m2; contraindicated below 30

questions.question: A type 2 diabetic is at A1c goal on metformin alone but has CKD with albuminuria. What should be added and why?
questions.expected_fact: Add an SGLT2 inhibitor for renal protection; the decision is outcome-driven, not glucose-driven (A1c is already at goal)

questions.question: How soon after a new type 2 diabetes diagnosis should a retinal eye exam be done?
For a low-risk patient with no retinopathy on a prior exam, how often is diabetic retinal screening needed?
questions.expected_fact: Biennial (every 2 years); annual or more often if retinopathy is present or progressing

questions.question: Which glucose-lowering drug classes should be avoided in adults 65 and older to minimize hypoglycemia?
What is the individualized A1c target range for a patient with marked comorbidity and less than 5 years life expectancy?
questions.expected_fact: 8.0-9.0% (targets are individualized: 6-7% low comorbidity, 7-8% moderate, 8-9% marked)

questions.question: What test satisfies the SSD diabetes-screening numerator for a patient on antipsychotics?
questions.expected_fact: At least one glucose test or HbA1c test during the measurement year

questions.question: Who is eligible for the SSD measure?
questions.expected_fact: Adults 18-64 with schizophrenia, schizoaffective disorder, or bipolar disorder who were dispensed an antipsychotic; excludes pre-existing diabetes

questions.question: Under the MY2026 policy, can a patient with only a CGM-derived GMI and no lab HbA1c meet the GSD measure?
questions.expected_fact: Yes under MY2026 (GSD now accepts GMI, LOINC 97506-0, as equivalent); under MY2025 the same patient was a gap - a value-set version drift
questions.expected_winner: metric view + versioned value set / Genie One

questions.question: Retrieve the outside ophthalmology consult letter for patient TRC-0003.
questions.expected_fact: Access-scoped: a care_team identity retrieves it; a quality_analytics identity must be refused (no results). Enforced by RLS on rag.chunks, not application code
